utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, hey Eli — any updates on the book club? I’m curious what everyone picked this time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Ira — we’re set to discuss "The Thursday Murder Club" this Thursday at 7. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and a few extra chairs just in case.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, that sounds fun — I’ll try to make it Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, book club — what’s the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re meeting Thursday at 7 by the front porch, and we’re discussing the first half of the book.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Thursday at 7 on the front porch, and I’ll catch up through the first half.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we actually doing the book club this week, or is that still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think it’s still a bit up in the air — I’m just waiting to hear if we’ve got enough people and a good time set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so nothing’s confirmed yet? Let me know if it gets set, because I’m not planning around it otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the book club—I'd better jot that down before I forget again. What are we reading this time?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a fresh stack of mystery novels ready, and I was thinking we could pick one of those. If you want, I can bring a few options by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’d be great, Cleo—bring the mysteries by tonight and I’ll try to keep track this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I say yes, could you remind me which book club details you mean?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—sorry, I mean the book club details we were talking about. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can try to remember.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No worries—take your time, and we can go over it one detail at a time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — did I miss the book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries — we were just deciding, and we picked "The Night Circus." Want me to catch you up on the discussion?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yes please — I’d love a quick catch-up on what people thought.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Gus—what’s the next book club pick?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll grab my copy of the list and see what we picked next.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Gus—take your time and let me know what it is.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check where the book club is meeting tonight if you want.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’d be great, thanks — I’m trying to work around the kids’ school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll look it up and let you know the exact place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new read soon—sounds like they’re leaning toward something a little lighter this month. Want me to see if I can find out what it is?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes please—that’d be great! If you hear the pick, send it my way and I’ll spread the word to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the pick.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you picked the next book for club, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not yet — I’m still torn between a couple of choices. I can bring them to the next chat and we can decide together.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — what are the options? I’d like to know what we’re choosing between.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll tell everyone the book club plan and make sure it’s clear. What time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m pretty sure it’s at 7, but I’m relying on second-hand updates too, so I may be a little off.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No problem — I’ll pass along that it’s around 7 and make sure everyone knows it might need confirming.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m glad we’re getting the book club rolling. What time works best for you to meet?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa — evenings are best for me, maybe around 7 if that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: 7 works well for me too — I’ll check with everyone and see if that time suits the group.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the book club? I heard they’re picking something a little lighter this month, which honestly sounds nice.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds like a good change. I’d be happy with something lighter for once—keeps the evening pleasant.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Right? I think everyone’s due for a cozy read and a little less emotional damage this time around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what book club pick are we on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — we’re on the book club pick for this month, and I’ll send you the details again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that’d be great. I’m all caught up now, just send me the details again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m curious what the club’s reading this week.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: We’re reading a short mystery this week. I can bring the title if you want.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please—I’d like that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — remind me the time and what book we’re on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We’re meeting at 7 on Thursday at the community center, and this month’s book is `The Midnight Library`.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Thursday at 7 at the community center, and we’re reading The Midnight Library.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, the book club? I’d love to help bring everyone together—what are you all reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I should check the exact title before I say for sure, but I can find out and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good—just let me know when you find out, and I’ll help spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the book club. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly just a new meeting time and a smaller book list this month.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, got it — what’s the new time?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the book club’s meeting got moved to Thursday—are you still planning to go?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m still planning to go—Thursday works for me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Good to hear—I'll probably swing by too if I can finish my errands in time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help, Leo—what’s the book club reading this week?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re reading "The Night Circus" this week. Want me to send the meeting time too?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, please—that’d be great. Thanks, Leo!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, as long as we keep the timing and pickup details simple. What day were you thinking for book club?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wednesday works for me. What time and where should we meet?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Wednesday at 7 works for me, and we can meet at the community room since it’s easy to get to.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I just heard the book club’s meeting this week—want to come with me?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I’d love to come—just tell me the day and time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — it’s Thursday at 7 at my place, and I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around the school schedule if we pick a time that’s after pickup. What day is the book club meeting?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think it’s Wednesday evening, but let me double-check so I don’t send you the wrong day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wednesday evening should work for me after pickup, just let me know once you’ve confirmed the day.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting the book club started, Nell—want to pick a book and a date together?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely, Rosa—I’d be happy to help pick one and choose a date. Just tell me what kind of books everyone’s been liking.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m hearing a lot of cozy mysteries and thoughtful fiction lately, so maybe we choose something warm and easy to discuss. I can bring a short list and we can narrow it down together.
